title: eXplaining to Learn (eX2L): Regularization Using Contrastive Visual Explanation Pairs for Distribution Shifts
abstract: arXiv:2605.06368v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Despite extensive research into mitigating distribution shifts, many existing algorithms yield inconsistent performance, often failing to outperform baseline Empirical Risk Minimization (ERM) across diverse scenarios and necessitating newer algorithms which can handle scenarios where existing algorithms currently underperform. Furthermore, high algorithmic complexity frequently limits interpretability and offers only an indirect means of addressing spurious correlations. We propose eXplaining to Learn (eX2L): an interpretable, explanation-based framework that decorrelates confounding features from a classifier's latent representations during training. eX2L achieves this by penalizing the similarity between Grad-CAM activation maps generated by a primary label classifier and those from a concurrently trained confounder classifier. translated_title: eXplaining to Learn (eX2L)：利用对比视觉解释对进行分布偏移的正则化
translated_abstract: 尽管在缓解分布偏移方面已有大量研究，许多现有算法的性能表现并不稳定，在多样化场景中往往无法超越基线经验风险最小化（ERM），因此需要新的算法来应对现有算法目前表现不佳的场景。此外，算法复杂度高常常限制了可解释性，且只能以间接的方式处理虚假相关性问题。我们提出了 eXplaining to Learn (eX2L)：一个可解释的、基于解释的框架，在训练过程中将混淆特征与分类器的潜在表示进行去相关。eX2L 通过惩罚主标签分类器生成的 Grad-CAM 激活图与同时训练的混淆因子分类器生成的激活图之间的相似性来实现这一目标。在严格的 Spawrious 多对多困难挑战合成数据基准上，eX2L 取得了（摘要内容在此处截断）
tldr: 提出 eX2L 框架，通过惩罚主分类器与混淆因子分类器的 Grad-CAM 激活图相似性来去除混淆特征与潜在表示的相关性，从而以可解释的方式提升模型在分布偏移下的表现。
